استدركنا (form X)
# اِسْتَدْرَكْنَا (istadraknā) /is.tad.rak.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
# اُسْتُدْرِكْنَا (ustudriknā) /us.tud.rik.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَدْرَكَ (istadraka)
